book.short: On the Language of the So-called Kafirs of the Indian Caucasus
book.title: On the Language of the so-called Kafirs of the Indian Caucasus
book.author: Ernest Trumpp
book.imprint: Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland, 19, 1862, pp. 1-29

provenance.collector: Ernest Trumpp, from three Kafirs recruited by Major Lumsden at Mardan and sent to Peshawar via Col. Herbert Edwardes, with Muhammad Rasul, a Kuhistani of Panjcore, as interpreter

scan.rights: Public domain scan; image via Internet Archive

transcription: Transcribed from the scan; spellings kept as printed
about: Trumpp took down the Kafir words at Peshawar from three Kafir men brought from Mardan, with the Panjcore Kuhistani Muhammad Rasul interpreting, and added a short Kuhistani (Kooner) list and Burnes's earlier forms for comparison.
